purpose: Educational decision boundaries, not an exhaustive legal adjudicator

rows.evidence: Return receipt, posting, payment, extensions and assessment validity
rows.decision_boundary: Correct invalid assessment first; do not consume FTA

rows.evidence: Exact statutory subsection and return type
rows.decision_boundary: Listed provisions only; incomplete entity returns excluded

rows.evidence: Three annual periods or twelve quarters, relevant related accounts and penalty reversal reasons
rows.decision_boundary: Prior FTA/AEP, tolerance and unresolved penalties block the modeled route; estimated-only and qualifying reversals differ

rows.evidence: Currently required returns or valid extensions; tax paid or payment arranged
rows.decision_boundary: Full payment is not necessarily required; missing facts require review

rows.evidence: Original due date, period and actual AEP consideration
rows.decision_boundary: FTA is replaced by AEP for covered original due dates; transition cases need processing evidence

rows.evidence: Original due date, receipt date, eligible form and tax period
rows.decision_boundary: Return must be received within three years of original due date; extension date is not substituted

rows.evidence: Compliance indicators for three prior years or twelve quarters; related accounts
rows.decision_boundary: Require transcript verification; never infer compliance from missing records

rows.scope: Form CT-1 or specific preventing administrative error
rows.evidence: Original-return qualification, error evidence, and later history for late-filed returns
rows.decision_boundary: Manual consideration; subsequent three-year relief history must also be checked

rows.evidence: Counted waiver codes; electronic-deposit avoidance component
rows.decision_boundary: Four or more relevant waivers block; partial FTA avoidance assessment requires allocation

rows.evidence: Ordinary care, actual inability, causal dates, correction and no willful neglect
rows.decision_boundary: Individualized statutory exception; no automatic grant

rows.evidence: Circumstances, ordinary care, causal link and no willful neglect
Reasonable-cause facts for late or incomplete entity return
rows.decision_boundary: A separate statutory route remains possible when FTA is outside scope

rows.evidence: Exact component, reasonable cause, good faith, and reliability of any advice
rows.decision_boundary: Ordinary route subject to express statutory exclusions and special valuation conditions

rows.evidence: Unusual circumstances and inequity, or qualifying recent retirement/disability with RC and no willful neglect
rows.decision_boundary: No general reasonable-cause route; statutory determination required

rows.evidence: Mitigating factors or uncontrollable impediment plus responsible conduct
rows.decision_boundary: Refer to the separate information-reporting standard

rows.evidence: Notice, proper form, separate periods, evidence and submission record
rows.decision_boundary: Follow current instructions; no universal form or deadline inferred
rows.pinpoint: Purpose of Form; Separate Form Required

rows.evidence: Specific statutory conditions and documentary evidence
